title: 冰雪奇緣
description: 迪士尼經典動畫，艾莎與安娜的冒險故事

sentences.en: The cold never bothered me anyway.
sentences.zh: 寒冷從來沒有困擾過我。

sentences.en: Do you want to build a snowman?
Some people are worth melting for.
Love is putting someone else's needs before yours.
sentences.zh: 愛是把別人的需求放在你之前。

sentences.en: Be the good one. Be the better one.
sentences.zh: 做好的那一個。做更好的那一個。
我們吃完對方的三明治。

sentences.en: I never knew what I was until I met you.
sentences.zh: 遇到你之前我不知道自己是誰。
